markdown.markdown:
I am a scientific computing engineer enthusiast about simulation and artificial intelligence. 
My background bridges classical numerical methods with modern machine learning architectures for high-performance computing. 

I am currently pursuing a PhD at INRIA Sophia-Antipolis (France) working on *Cardioembolic Stroke Risk Stratification using AI Accelerated Patient-Specific Blood Flow Simulation* supervised by Maxime Sermesant.
My drive to pursue a PhD is inspired by my brother Antoine, some of my teachers that were very passionate, and great researchers such as Ron Fedkiw.
Therefore, I am endlessly fascinated about numerical modeling in research and eager to keep pushing boundaries.

## Research Interests
Here are my main interests in science that drive me.

- **AI:** Physics-Informed Neural Networks, surrogate models, reinforcement learning.
- **Computational Fluid Dynamics:** Lattice Boltzmann Method, Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics, Navier-Stokes solvers (PISO).
- **Numerical Methods:** PDEs, Finite Differences/Volumes/Elements, Discontinuous Galerkin.
- **High-Performance Computing:** GPU parallelization, MPI, rendering (Shaders).

## Education
- **SeaTech Engineering School (2023 - 2026)** - M.Sc. in Modeling and Scientific Computing.
- **Bishop's University (2023)** - Exchange semester in Mathematics.
- **Université de Toulon (2021 - 2023)** - Bachelor in Mathematics.

## Research & Engineering Experience
- **Naval Group (2026)** - AI Software Engineering Intern. NLP, LLMs, software development, management.
- **University of Genoa (2025)** - Research Intern. SPH wave channel modeling (DualSPHysics) on GPU cluster, multi-sensor data processing.

More in my [long resume](resume.qmd).

## Some of my most recent [projects](projects.qmd)
- Real-time LBM wind tunnel
- Taylor-Green vortex simulation using PINNs 

## Miscellaneous
- I have been the vice-president of the Athlétique Club Gardéen since 2024, a weightlifting club near Toulon in France. I also [competed in powerlifting](https://www.openpowerlifting.org/u/arthurchanlock) and participated in the 2024 French benchpress championship.
- I also like to play gypsy guitar.
